# haruspex → engineering_research 有无条件产出（base）或全部无条件

            colony = {

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_miner_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_miner_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
    }
}

# mining_drone → minerals 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger
bca_jr_has_output_mining_drone_minerals = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            colony = {
                NOR = {
                    has_deposit = d_space_ship_graveyard
                    is_planet_class = pc_shattered_ring_habitable
                }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            colony = {
                OR = {
                    has_deposit = d_space_ship_graveyard
                    is_planet_class = pc_shattered_ring_habitable
                }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            colony = {
                miner_is_thermoforger_trigger = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# politician → engineering_research 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger
bca_jr_has_output_politician_engineering_research = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            colony = {
                politician_is_science_director = yes
            }
        }
        AND = {
            colony = {
                politician_is_technophant = yes
            }
        }
    }
}


bca_jr_should_inc_politician_for_physics_research = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_politician_physics_research = yes
    }
}

bca_jr_should_inc_politician_for_society_research = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_politician_society_research = yes
    }
}

bca_jr_should_inc_politician_for_engineering_research = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_politician_engineering_research = yes
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_politician = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_politician_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_politician_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_politician_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_inc_test_subject_for_society_research = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_test_subject_society_research = yes
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_test_subject = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_test_subject_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_test_subject_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_test_subject_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
    }
}

# wrangler → society_research 有无条件产出（base）或全部无条件
bca_jr_has_output_wrangler_society_research = {
    always = yes
}

# wrangler → food 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger
bca_jr_has_output_wrangler_food = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            wrangler_is_trophy_hunter_trigger = yes
                        wrangler_is_beastfighter_trigger = no
        }
    }
}


bca_jr_should_inc_wrangler_for_society_research = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_wrangler_society_research = yes
    }
}

bca_jr_should_inc_wrangler_for_food = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_wrangler_food = yes
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_wrangler = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_wrangler_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_wrangler_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
    }
}
